health-data-services-dicom-metadata.title: DICOM also needs structured storage
health-data-services-dicom-metadata.body: This estimate stores DICOM images but no structured storage. Microsoft bills the images as blob storage and the DICOM metadata as structured storage, so the structured-storage figure should include the metadata (usually small next to the images, but not zero).

citation.quote: DICOM images incur BLOB storage charges based on the size of the object ingested and stored while its metadata will incur structured storage charges.
